messages.message: Hi! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I'm Lucy. How can I help you today? 😊
Hey Lucy, my internet has been cutting out all morning. It's super annoying.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Sure, account number is 89774974 and my dob is 04/08/1968. I'm James Wilson by the way.
Thanks, James. I see there's some instability in the local exchange. I totally understand how frustrating it is when your connection drops during the day.
Yeah, it's a nightmare. I'm trying to work from home. My phone number is 94760 01182 if that helps.
I can assure you there won't be any more outages in your area.
You say that, but it's happened three times this week. I'm honestly about to just switch to another provider.
I'm sorry, but there isn't much more I can do from my end right now. We are just waiting on the engineers.

That's useless! I'm paying for a service I'm not getting. I'll just pay my current bill now to clear it so I can leave. My card is four one four seven one zero four nine seven four six five zero seven five two.
I've noted the payment. Is there anything else I can help you with today? We'll just have to wait for the network team to update the status. Goodbye!
No, nothing else. This is ridiculous. Bye.
